Allah says the son of Adam hurts Him by cursing Time, for He is Time, alternating night and day; nor should grapes be called karm, for karm is the believer.
None should say 'my bondman' or 'my slave-girl', for all are Allah's bondmen, nor call a master 'my lord', nor say 'my soul has become evil'.
When two people abuse each other, the sin falls on the one who began, as long as the wronged one does not go beyond the limit.
The Prophet said that a man who says people are ruined is himself ruined.
A servant may speak words, not weighing their consequence, that sink him into the Fire farther than the distance between east and west.
